# Æsir Automotive Ltd — Independent BMW Specialists, Uxbridge

> Independent BMW-group specialist garage in Uxbridge, West London, run by
> Neil Haddow since 2020. Servicing, dealer-level diagnostics, electrical
> work and full in-house engine rebuilds for BMW, M cars, MINI and
> Rolls-Royce — plus late-20th-century classics and occasional Ferrari work.
> Rated 5.0 from 20 Google reviews.

## Key facts
- Business: Aesir Automotive Ltd (Companies House no. 12705996, incorporated 30 June 2020)
- Owner/mechanic: Neil Haddow — customers deal directly with him, no service desk
- Address: 3d Pond Farm, Newyears Green Lane, Newyears Green, Uxbridge UB9 6LX, UK
- Phone / WhatsApp: 07956 658177 (+44 7956 658177)
- Hours: Monday–Friday 08:00–18:00
- Area served: Uxbridge, Harefield, Ickenham, Ruislip, Hillingdon and north-west London
- Rating: 5.0 stars, 20 Google reviews (reviewers highlight knowledge, clear
  explanations, transparency and fair pricing)
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/aesir.automotive/

## Services
- Full engine rebuilds and machining, in-house (bearings, skimmed heads, bottom
  ends — from BMW M V10s to classic straight-sixes)
- Manufacturer-schedule servicing with genuine/OEM parts
- Dealer-level engine diagnostics
- Brakes and suspension
- Electrical fault-finding, battery registration and module coding
- Air conditioning re-gas and leak detection
- Classic BMW restoration (late-20th-century models are the specialty)
- Pre-purchase inspections
- MOT preparation and repairs, with automatic MOT/service text reminders

## Notable work (from the public Instagram feed)
- BMW E60 M5 Touring S85 V10 — bottom-end bearings
- Rolls-Royce Ghost — oil leaks and Spirit of Ecstasy mechanism repair
- Ferrari F430 — multiple misfires diagnosed
- BMW Z3 M Coupé — S50B32 engine rebuild and refit
